a: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
p: Allāhumma rabbanā anzil ʿalaynā mā'idatan mina-s-samā'i takūnu lanā ʿīdan li-awwalinā wa ākhirinā wa āyatan mink, wa-rzuqnā wa anta khayru-r-rāziqīn.
m: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allāh, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
